title: 天命所歸
intro:
2026年5月29日，由李君羨親王殿下獨自譜曲完成《天命所歸》，並於2026年6月1日即位日當天，在皇家音樂廳的女皇即位受錄聖銜大典中首版發布。這是專為該神聖威嚴儀式所鑄造的尊榮典禮樂。全曲奉行極致的「電影感巨石主義（Cinematic Brutalism）」，徹底摒棄世俗音樂的旋律、和弦與繁複節奏，轉而追求純粹由超低頻構成的壓倒性權威，完美具象化了「代天御人」那種不容置疑、穩如泰山的天命氣勢。

On May 29, 2026, "Sovereign Destiny" was solely composed by His Imperial Highness Prince Li Junxian, and premiered on June 1, 2026—the coronation day—at the Royal Concert Hall as a prestigious ceremonial music piece crafted specifically for the Empress's sacred title conferment ceremony during her ascension. The entire composition strictly embraces the extreme philosophy of "Cinematic Brutalism," thoroughly abandoning the melodies, chords, and intricate rhythms of secular music.
